HelpService

class HelpService[source]

Bases: object

Locate, register and query the compiled help.

Attributes:
HOME_TOPICstr, class attribute

Topic opened when no other topic applies ("inicio").

HELP_ID_PROPERTYstr, class attribute

Qt property that overrides the topic of a widget and its children, e.g. widget.setProperty("help_id", "calibracao").

VIRTUAL_FOLDERstr, class attribute

Virtual folder of the pages inside the help ("doc").

TOPICSdict[str, str], class attribute

Topic id to page path inside the help, the same in every language.

VIEW_TOPICSdict[str, str], class attribute

Screen class name to topic id. Used by F1 to find the topic of the active screen without changing the screens.

Notes

Typical use: engine = service.create_engine("en_US") and then service.topic_url(engine, "cadastro_jogador").

Methods

Requested language code, e.g. "es_ES".

Returns:
str

language if its help file exists, otherwise the default language.

create_engine(language)[source]

Create a help engine for language.

Parameters:
languagestr

Language code; falls back to the default language when its help file is missing.

Returns:
QHelpEngine

Engine ready to use. The caller owns it.

Raises:

topic_for_widget(widget)[source]

Return the topic id for widget or its nearest parent.

A help_id property wins over the screen class name. Widgets without a topic inherit the topic of their parent window, up to the main window.

Parameters:
widgetQWidget | None

Widget with focus, or the active window.

Returns:
str

Topic id; HOME_TOPIC when nothing matches.

topic_url(engine, topic)[source]

Return the URL of topic in the help of engine.

Parameters:
engineQHelpEngineCore

Engine returned by create_engine.

topicstr

Topic id from TOPICS. Unknown topics and missing pages fall back to the home page.

Returns:
QUrl

qthelp://<namespace>/doc/<page> URL of the first registered documentation.

Raises:
HelpUnavailableError

If the engine has no registered documentation.
